Earlier 'CPU has a real bug' was OVER-ATTRIBUTED: never version-matched.

SESSION_CONSOLIDATION.KEY_UNRESOLVED: The teacher-forced capture is PREFILL; provenance shows _batched_mla_attend (decode attention) did NOT mark sparse_attend during it -> the PREFILL attention path that produced the 0.82 divergence is NOT yet identified. _torch_flash_mla_with_kvcache is installed for all flash_mla calls (line 2486) but either returns early in prefill or prefill uses a different compute. MUST identify the exact prefill attention op before fixing.
SESSION_CONSOLIDATION.next_concrete_step: Instrument the ACTUAL prefill attention op with per-op I/O capture (q,k,v,sink,out) at layer 0; write an INDEPENDENT fp32 MLA reference from the authoritative formula; feed it the captured GPU inputs (validate reference == GPU out) then CPU inputs (localize: if CPU-out != reference(CPU-in) the compute is wrong; if equal but CPU-in != GPU-in the bug is upstream).
